{
  "name": "high-command",
  "version": "1.1.1",
  "description": "See the messages your teammates, named subagents, and other Claude Code sessions send you, grouped by peer with unread counts: a pane, a band above the prompt, and /highcommand.",
  "author": {
    "name": "dot-agi"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/dot-agi/high-command",
  "repository": "https://github.com/dot-agi/high-command",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/high-command/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/high-command/blob/main/docs/usage.md",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/high-command#privacy",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "claude-code",
    "agent-teams",
    "messaging",
    "inbox"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "icon": "./docs/images/icon.png",
  "userConfig": {
    "agentLanesInBand": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Agent lanes in the band and status line",
      "description": "Add the unread count of all agent lanes to the band and the status line. Read all in the band then also marks every agent lane read, and Hide also covers agent lanes. Off: the band and the status line count the main inbox only.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
